Car crashes into crowd in Australia, injuring 10

A car crashed into a crowd of rugby fans north of Sydney, Australia, injuring 10 people. Two individuals were reported to be in critical condition: a five-year-old girl and a 67-year-old man. The incident occurred near Newcastle, involving fans of the Newcastle Knights. A P-plater has been charged in connection with the incident.
